name: OmaControl
author: Tobias Wiking
description: One window for every Omarchy setting, from Hyprland to your keybindings to tmux. Searchable, and anything you change can be put back.

schema.label: Show active-switch count
schema.description: Counts Night light, Do not disturb and Stay awake on the gear.

schema.label: Show network warning
schema.description: Marks the gear when there is no network at all. A click then opens Network.

schema.label: Show battery warnings
schema.description: Marks the gear when the laptop or a Bluetooth device is at 10 % or under. A click then opens Power or Bluetooth.
